title: Paired mechanism audit for the R6N D4 flux-policy divergence
question: Which public-observation, BP-state, and correction-topology features distinguish the 25 R6D-BP-over-O2 improvements from the one regression in the frozen default-cell cohort?
acceptance: every reconstructed public observation, O2 correction, and BP correction equals its frozen R6N record
all group counts sum to the 100-record nonterminal cohort
physical truth is used only for post-decode Boolean-union classification
claim_boundary: Descriptive mechanism audit only. Feature associations do not establish a causal explanation or promote the local BP posterior to an exact D4 posterior.

execution.mechanism_signal: All 25 BP improvements reproduce the physical correction while O2 does not; the one BP regression has the reverse property and is converged, so it is not explained by nonconvergence.
